\pdfvariable compresslevel=0
\pdfvariable objcompresslevel=0
\documentclass[paper={a5paper},maintitle={Melody Syntax Test}]{ulsbs-songbook}
\begin{document}
\begin{ulSongs}{}
\beginsong{Melody Syntax}[key={C}]
  \beginverse+
    \[<C>]one \[<C D E>Am]two \[<;E>]three \[<C;E>Am]four
    \[<C D;E F>G]five \[<C @ .3em>]six \[<C @ -.3em>Am]seven
    \[<C D;E F @ .3em>]eight \[<A _ C;E _ G>]gaps \[</>Am]unpitched \[<A / C;E _ G>]slash slot \[<* A _ * C>Am]beats
    \[<A B C;E * G>Am]secondary beat \[<* @ 1em>]beat-only offset
    \[<C# D& F;A C>Am]accidentals
    \[<*A_C;E*G@.2em>Am]compact
    \[<!C>]zero-advance note \[<!*>]zero-advance beat \[<!ABC@1em>Am]zero-advance adjusted melody with chord
  \endverse
  {\ulMelodySecondaryPosition{below}\ulMelodyStyleMapping{swapped}
    \beginverse+
      \[<C;E>Am]policy \[<C D;E F @ -.4em>G]offset \[<C D @ -.4em>]negative no chord
    \endverse}
  {\ulMelodySecondaryPosition{same}
    \beginverse+
      \[<;E>Am]secondary normal lane \[<C;E>Am]explicit overlay
    \endverse}
  {\ulMelodyPrimaryPosition{low}
    \beginverse
      {\ulMelodySecondaryPosition{above}\[<C;E>Am]low/above}
      {\ulMelodySecondaryPosition{same}\[<C;E>Am]low/same}
      {\ulMelodySecondaryPosition{below}\[<C;E>Am]low/below}
    \endverse}
  \notesoff
  \beginverse+
    \[<C D;E F>Am]hidden notes \[<* C>G]visible beat
  \endverse
  \noteson\beatsoff
  \beginverse+
    \[<* C>Am]hidden beat
  \endverse
  \beatson\transpose{2}
  \beginverse+
    \[<C D# E& /;A C>Am]transposed
  \endverse
\endsong
\end{ulSongs}
\makeatletter
\ulMelodyStyleMapping{normal}\ulsbs@melodystyle{primary}
\ifulsbs@altmnstyle\PackageError{melody-syntax}{normal primary style was alternate}{}\fi
\ulsbs@melodystyle{secondary}
\ifulsbs@altmnstyle\else\PackageError{melody-syntax}{normal secondary style was primary}{}\fi
\ulMelodyStyleMapping{swapped}\ulsbs@melodystyle{primary}
\ifulsbs@altmnstyle\else\PackageError{melody-syntax}{swapped primary style was not alternate}{}\fi
\ulsbs@melodystyle{secondary}
\ifulsbs@altmnstyle\PackageError{melody-syntax}{swapped secondary style was not primary}{}\fi
\ulMelodyStyleMapping{normal}
\makeatother
\end{document}
